The '''Meri–Teltior war''' was a conflict fought for a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] on [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] between the indigenous [[Meri]]s and [[Teltior]]s. It was fought thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at some point before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="PotG3" />
